Title: Relates to limits on outside earned income by members; repealer
Summary: Repeals limits on outside earned income by members of the legislature.
LawCode: Rpld §5-b, amd §80, Leg L; amd §94, Exec L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the legislative law and the executive law, in relation to limits on outside earned income by members; and to repeal certain provisions of the legislative law relating thereto
